newsitem.title: QATAR: Financial stocks lead Qatar market up in week.
newsitem.headline: Financial stocks lead Qatar market up in week.

text.p: Financial stocks led Qatar's unofficial market slightly higher in the week to Thursday but blue chips remained steady, brokers said.

"Continued activity was seen especially in banks' shares...While market leaders, Qatar National Bank and Qatar Insurance Company, settled at their (previous) level," said Mazin al-Shakarchi, a market analyst.
The 18-share Commercial Bank of Qatar (CBQ) index inched up to 120.97 points from a previous 120.70.
Eight shares rose and 10 remained unchanged.
Among the gainers were CBQ, which advanced three riyals to 338, and Doha Bank Ltd, which gained two riyals to 270. Al Ahli Bank of Qatar picked up one riyal to 213.
Qatar General Insurance rose five riyals to 530 and al-Khaleej Insurance added three riyals to 288.
Extending the previous week's gains, Qatar Navigation and Qatar Cement each gained five riyals to 700 and 300 respectively. Qatar Flour Mills was three riyals higher at 303.
